plugins.name: luci-app-openclash
plugins.desc: OpenClash 代理客户端(mihomo 内核,官方 APK,含全部依赖)
plugins.cmd: apk add --allow-untrusted bash dnsmasq-full curl ca-bundle ip-full ruby ruby-yaml kmod-tun kmod-inet-diag unzip kmod-nft-tproxy luci-compat luci luci-base && wget -q -O /tmp/openclash.apk '{URL}' && apk add -q --force-overwrite --clean-protected --allow-untrusted /tmp/openclash.apk && rm -f /tmp/openclash.apk

plugins.name: luci-app-daed
plugins.desc: daed 大鹅代理客户端(dae 内核,上游仅提供 x86_64/aarch64/i386 架构)
plugins.cmd: . /etc/openwrt_release; R="releases/$DISTRIB_RELEASE"; [ "$DISTRIB_RELEASE" = "SNAPSHOT" ] && R="snapshots"; B=$(grep -hoE "https?://[^ \"]+/(releases|snapshots)/[^ \"]*/targets/" /etc/apk/repositories /etc/apk/repositories.d/*.list 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed "s#/\(releases\|snapshots\)/.*##"); [ -z "$B" ] && B="https://downloads.openwrt.org"; T="$B/$R/targets/$DISTRIB_TARGET/packages/packages.adb"; grep -rqF "$T" /etc/apk/repositories /etc/apk/repositories.d/ 2>/dev/null || echo "$T" >> /etc/apk/repositories; apk update --allow-untrusted && A=$(apk --print-arch); case "$A" in aarch64*) F=aarch64_generic;; x86_64) F=x86_64;; i386|x86) F=i386_pentium4;; *) echo "daed 仅支持 x86_64/aarch64/i386 架构,当前为 $A"; exit 1;; esac && wget -q -O /tmp/daed_core.apk 'https://github.com/QiuSimons/luci-app-daed/releases/download/daed_2026.07.31-r1/daed-2026.07.31-r1-'"$F"'-openwrt-25.12.apk' && wget -q -O /tmp/daed_luci.apk '{URL}' && wget -q -O /tmp/daed_i18n.apk 'https://github.com/QiuSimons/luci-app-daed/releases/download/daed_2026.07.31-r1/luci-i18n-daed-zh-cn-25.283.11553.bce4b5f-openwrt-25.12.apk' && apk add --allow-untrusted /tmp/daed_core.apk /tmp/daed_luci.apk /tmp/daed_i18n.apk && rm -f /tmp/daed_*.apk

plugins.name: luci-app-passwall
plugins.desc: PassWall 代理客户端(官方 apk 源直装,自动添加 passwall-build 源,依赖全自动解析)
plugins.cmd: . /etc/openwrt_release; REL=${DISTRIB_RELEASE%.*}; P="https://master.dl.sourceforge.net/project/openwrt-passwall-build"; wget -q -O /etc/apk/keys/openwrt-passwall-build.pem "$P/apk.pub" || { echo "密钥下载失败"; exit 1; }; if [ "$DISTRIB_RELEASE" = "SNAPSHOT" ]; then B="$P/snapshots/packages/$DISTRIB_ARCH"; else B="$P/releases/packages-$REL/$DISTRIB_ARCH"; fi; touch /etc/apk/repositories.d/customfeeds.list; for f in passwall_luci passwall_packages; do U="$B/$f/packages.adb"; grep -qF "$U" /etc/apk/repositories.d/customfeeds.list || echo "$U" >> /etc/apk/repositories.d/customfeeds.list; done; apk update && apk add --allow-untrusted luci-app-passwall luci-i18n-passwall-zh-cn

plugins.name: luci-app-passwall2
plugins.desc: PassWall2 代理客户端(官方 apk 源直装,自动添加 passwall-build 源,依赖全自动解析)
plugins.cmd: . /etc/openwrt_release; REL=${DISTRIB_RELEASE%.*}; P="https://master.dl.sourceforge.net/project/openwrt-passwall-build"; wget -q -O /etc/apk/keys/openwrt-passwall-build.pem "$P/apk.pub" || { echo "密钥下载失败"; exit 1; }; if [ "$DISTRIB_RELEASE" = "SNAPSHOT" ]; then B="$P/snapshots/packages/$DISTRIB_ARCH"; else B="$P/releases/packages-$REL/$DISTRIB_ARCH"; fi; touch /etc/apk/repositories.d/customfeeds.list; for f in passwall_luci passwall_packages passwall2; do U="$B/$f/packages.adb"; grep -qF "$U" /etc/apk/repositories.d/customfeeds.list || echo "$U" >> /etc/apk/repositories.d/customfeeds.list; done; apk update && apk add --allow-untrusted luci-app-passwall2 luci-i18n-passwall2-zh-cn

plugins.name: luci-app-nikki
plugins.desc: Nikki 代理客户端(mihomo 内核,官方 apk feed 直装,依赖自动解析)
plugins.cmd: . /etc/openwrt_release; case "$DISTRIB_RELEASE" in *25.12*) BR=openwrt-25.12;; SNAPSHOT) BR=SNAPSHOT;; *) echo "不支持的版本 $DISTRIB_RELEASE"; exit 1;; esac; wget -q -O /etc/apk/keys/nikki.pem https://nikkinikki.pages.dev/public-key.pem || { echo "密钥下载失败"; exit 1; }; touch /etc/apk/repositories.d/customfeeds.list; sed -i '/nikki/d' /etc/apk/repositories.d/customfeeds.list; echo "https://nikkinikki.pages.dev/$BR/$DISTRIB_ARCH/nikki/packages.adb" >> /etc/apk/repositories.d/customfeeds.list; apk update && apk add --allow-untrusted nikki luci-app-nikki luci-i18n-nikki-zh-cn

plugins.name: luci-app-mosdns
plugins.desc: MosDNS 插件式 DNS 转发器(v5 官方预编译包,按架构自动匹配)
plugins.pkg: mosdns luci-app-mosdns luci-i18n-mosdns-zh-cn geo2txt v2ray-geoip v2ray-geosite
plugins.cmd: mkdir -p /tmp/mosdns && cd /tmp/mosdns && . /etc/openwrt_release; wget -q -O mosdns.tar.gz 'https://github.com/sbwml/luci-app-mosdns/releases/download/v5.3.4-r14/'"$DISTRIB_ARCH"'-openwrt-25.12.tar.gz' && tar xzf mosdns.tar.gz && apk add --allow-untrusted packages_ci/*.apk; s=$?; cd /; rm -rf /tmp/mosdns; exit $s

plugins.name: luci-app-lucky
plugins.desc: Lucky 网络工具集(DDNS/反代/端口转发,含 LuCI 界面与中文翻译)
plugins.cmd: mkdir -p /tmp/lucky && cd /tmp/lucky && . /etc/openwrt_release; wget -q -O lucky.tar.gz 'https://github.com/sirpdboy/luci-app-lucky/releases/download/v2.27.2/SNAPSHOT-'"$DISTRIB_ARCH"'.tar.gz' && tar xzf lucky.tar.gz && apk add --allow-untrusted packages_ci/*.apk; s=$?; cd /; rm -rf /tmp/lucky; exit $s

plugins.name: luci-app-smartdns
plugins.desc: SmartDNS 智能分流 DNS(核心按路由器架构自动匹配,含中文界面)
plugins.cmd: A=$(apk --print-arch); case "$A" in x86_64) F=x86_64;; aarch64*) F=aarch64;; arm*) F=arm;; mipsel*) F=mipsel;; mips*) F=mips;; i386|x86) F=x86;; *) echo "不支持的架构 $A"; exit 1;; esac && wget -q -O /tmp/smartdns_core.apk 'https://github.com/pymumu/smartdns/releases/download/Release48.4/smartdns.1.2026.08.05-0921.'"$F"'-openwrt-all.apk' && wget -q -O /tmp/smartdns_luci.apk '{URL}' && apk add --allow-untrusted /tmp/smartdns_core.apk /tmp/smartdns_luci.apk && rm -f /tmp/smartdns_*.apk

plugins.name: arcane
plugins.desc: Arcane Docker 管理面板(自动安装 dockerd 并部署容器,Web 端口 3552,镜像来自 Docker Hub)
plugins.cmd: apk add --allow-untrusted dockerd docker && /etc/init.d/dockerd start && sleep 2 && docker rm -f arcane 2>/dev/null; KEY=$(head -c 24 /dev/urandom | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n'); docker run -d --name arcane --restart unless-stopped -p 3552:3552 -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock -v arcane-data:/app/data -e ENCRYPTION_KEY="$KEY" -e TZ=Asia/Shanghai getarcaneapp/manager:latest && echo "ARCANE_OK 面板地址: http://路由器IP:3552"

plugins.name: luci-app-store
plugins.desc: iStore 软件商店(OpenWRT 标准软件中心,纯脚本实现,搜索安装插件与教程,仅支持 x86_64/arm64)
plugins.cmd: cd /tmp && wget -q -O istore-reinstall.run '{URL}' && chmod 755 istore-reinstall.run && ./istore-reinstall.run && rm -f istore-reinstall.run

plugins.name: luci-app-uninstall
plugins.desc: 高级卸载(iStoreOS 一键不留痕卸载插件,删除配置/卸载依赖/清空缓存,支持 X86/ARM)
plugins.cmd: cd /tmp && wget -q -O uninstall.run '{URL}' && chmod 755 uninstall.run && ./uninstall.run && rm -f uninstall.run
